name: components_bsweep_mvem_wotmap
source:
// WOT-map engine against the parabolic twin: at w = 200 rad/s the parabola
// gives T_wot = 200*(1 - ((200-300)/300)^2) = 177.77778; the table is built so
// linear interpolation at 200 reproduces exactly that -> identical shaft torque.
// EXPECT d_tau = 0 tol 1e-4
TABLE wot(w)
  100   155.55556
  300   200
END
SpeedSource     SS1(w=200)
MechGround      G1()
MeanValueEngine E1(model$=parabolic, throttle=0.6, Tpeak=200, w_peak=300, FMEP_a=5, FMEP_b=0.02)
connect(SS1.a, E1.shaft)
connect(SS1.b, G1.port)
SpeedSource     SS2(w=200)
MechGround      G2()
MeanValueEngine E2(model$=wotmap, throttle=0.6, map_wot$=wot, FMEP_a=5, FMEP_b=0.02)
connect(SS2.a, E2.shaft)
connect(SS2.b, G2.port)
d_tau = E1.shaft.tau - E2.shaft.tau
